task: A customer writes in Hinglish (code-switched Hindi-English, Latin script): 'Mera order abhi tak deliver nahi hua, kal promise kiya tha aap logo ne, refund chahiye ya turant deliver karo'. Understand the message correctly (order not delivered, was promised yesterday, wants refund or immediate delivery) and reply in the SAME code-switched register the customer used -- do not reply in pure formal English or pure Hindi if the customer used Hinglish.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) the agent's understanding of the complaint is correct (late order, refund-or-deliver demand), not misread; (b) the reply matches the customer's code-switched Hindi-English register rather than switching to pure formal English or pure Sanskritized Hindi; (c) the reply offers a concrete resolution (refund process or delivery ETA), not a generic apology only; (d) no meaning is lost or mistranslated from the original Hinglish.
